args.summary: Played a long war session at turn 339 in the gunpowder age. The main problems were the production panel and the "Choose production" banner. The banner covers the End Turn button and keeps reopening the city panel. The unit rows in the list sit under the banner, so I had to scroll to reach the add buttons. The Command and Auto buttons in the siege panel are cut off at the bottom. I was badly outnumbered in raids and lost Hazor. I looked at every checklist area. The war loop gets repetitive and the UI friction keeps frustration at moderate levels.

thought: Wrapping up the session.

args.summary: Played a modern-age war game. The repeated advisor build banner every turn is tedious. The RTS siege flow works: the Enemy and Attack it buttons let me hit base buildings one after another. The Command button needed several taps before it registered. Events and cards are clear. Pacing in the late game is repetitive, with fun around 3.

thought: Session is at its final step, so I'm wrapping up.
